release_checks.name: s07-toolchain
command:
import pathlib,subprocess,json
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for cwd,cmd in [(root,["node","--version"]),(root,["pnpm","--version"]),(root/"backend",["go","version"]),(root,["docker","version","--format","{{.Client.Version}} / {{.Server.Version}}"]),(root,["docker","image","inspect","node:20-alpine","--format","{{.Id}}"])]:
 print("$",str(cwd),*cmd,flush=True)
 r=subprocess.run(["rtk","proxy",*cmd],cwd=cwd,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 print(r.stdout,end="",flush=True)
 print("exit_code="+str(r.returncode),flush=True)
 assert r.returncode==0 or cmd[:3]==["docker","image","inspect"]
for name in ["Dockerfile","deploy/Dockerfile"]:
 body=(root/name).read_text()
 assert "ARG GOLANG_IMAGE=golang:1.27.3-alpine" in body
 assert "ARG NODE_IMAGE=node:24-alpine" in body
 assert "pnpm@9" in body
 assert "-tags embed" in body
 print(name+": Go 1.27.3 / Node 24 / pnpm 9 / embed")
assert (root/"backend/go.mod").read_text().splitlines()[2]=="go 1.27.3"
for name in [".github/workflows/backend-ci.yml",".github/workflows/release.yml",".github/workflows/security-scan.yml"]:
 body=(root/name).read_text()
 assert "go1.27.3" in body
 print(name+": Go 1.27.3 check present")
print("VERSION="+(root/"backend/cmd/server/VERSION").read_text().strip())
print("lockfile="+(root/"frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml").read_text().splitlines()[0])
print("frontend_dist="+str((root/"backend/internal/web/dist/index.html").is_file()))

release_checks.name: s07-version-resolver
command:
import pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,shutil
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
work=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="sub2api-release-119-resolver-"))
script=work/"backend/scripts/resolve-version.sh"
script.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
shutil.copy2(root/"backend/scripts/resolve-version.sh",script)
version=work/"backend/cmd/server/VERSION"
version.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
version.write_text("1.1.19\n")
def run(*args):
 return subprocess.check_output(["rtk","proxy",*args],cwd=work,text=True).strip()
def check(label,expected):
 actual=run("sh",str(script)); print(label+": "+actual,flush=True); assert actual==expected
check("no git repository uses VERSION","1.1.19")
for args in [("init","-q"),("config","user.name","Release Version Fixture"),("config","user.email","release-fixture@example.com"),("commit","--allow-empty","-q","-m","fixture")]:
 run("git",*args)
check("untagged HEAD uses VERSION","1.1.19")
run("git","tag","-a","v9.9.8","-m","fixture tag precedence")
check("exact annotated v-tag takes precedence","9.9.8")
run("git","commit","--allow-empty","-q","-m","next fixture")
check("after tagged commit uses VERSION","1.1.19")
run("git","tag","-a","v1.1.19","-m","release fixture")
check("target annotated tag resolves 1.1.19","1.1.19")
print("workspace tags and HEAD untouched",flush=True)
shutil.rmtree(work)
